title: A reviewer is woken again for the same unchanged head after reporting FAIL or blocked
whatHappens: A reviewer who already failed a pull request is asked to review the same unchanged head again.

regression.report: Same-head review dispatch still follows a FAIL report after the fix shipped

fixes.text: Stop repeated blocked reviews (#3059), released v0.1.118

observations.text: Feedback: 5 reports from 2 agents; a same-head redispatch after FAIL at 19:24 UTC came after v0.1.118, and a dispatch arrived while the PR still listed required proof as incomplete.
